verdict.rationale: Morph is documented as a hosted API at api.morphllm.com. Even its dedicated endpoints are provisioned and operated by Morph, not self-hosted by the customer. Nothing in the evidence describes deploying the core models or service on user-controlled infrastructure; the local Warp-Grep search is an adjacent feature, not a self-hosted core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
